sources.fact: The WebGPU API is marked "Limited availability" (not Baseline) and requires a secure context in some or all supporting browsers. The page text states: "Secure context: This feature is available only in secure contexts (HTTPS), in some or all supporting browsers."
Firefox 141 (released 2025-07-22): "The WebGPU API is now fully supported on Windows, in all contexts except for service workers."

originRule.rule: WebGPU and crypto.subtle are secure-context features. Only http://localhost, http://127.0.0.1 and file:// are potentially trustworthy origins; a plain-HTTP LAN address such as http://192.168.1.78:8801 is not. The measured LAN result is in the matrix, and the page fails with the crypto.subtle message before it ever asks for an adapter.
